reason: 在冻结的四个 development 材料上，quantify「清退过拟合边界词表」是否使 item/关系门相对 r2-non-regression-policy-v1 逐类下限退化。词表已被证实（零调用探针 probe_lexicon_retirement.py）部分为样本级过拟合：_SAMPLE_SPECIFIC_BOUNDARY_PATTERNS 只在 dev-personal-trade-review 命中、在其它全部材料为 0；_DOMAIN_BOUNDARY_CUES 在非 dev 的光模块材料上仍有 0.994/千字命中，属行业通用而非样本答案。本预算只测「不退化」，不测泛化。

retirement_scope.note: 实现方式必须是把两个常量置空后由既有拼接式重建正则；不得改写通用词表或顶层分支顺序。

deterministic_stress_samples.source_path: data/corpus/9月8日 光模块技术演进与供应链重构：从1.6T到3.2T的路径、格局.docx
deterministic_stress_samples.role: 非 dev、非金标材料；仅用于域词命中率对比与确定性计划校验，不产生分数

model_binding: must equal configured_model() at plan time
planned_calls_basis: probe batch_plans.slots16_items64 over the full obligation set, per sample 5/4/1/33
candidate_slot_scope_note: 刻意不 pin 槽位子集：清退会改变槽位 ID，pin 旧集合必然触发 'frozen candidate slot scope drifted'。使用全量义务集。

metrics: coverage_lost_vs_current (strict single-slot containment of frozen gold evidence quotes)
cue hit rate per 1000 chars, dev materials vs stress material
stage0_deterministic_gate.pass: loss of strict obligation coverage for any frozen gold item == 0
stage0_deterministic_gate.fail_action: stop; no model call is made; report and backlog
stage0_deterministic_gate.note: 该口径是阻断性诊断，不是评分器；通过它只解除阻断，不构成任何通过结论。

out_of_scope: generalisation / overfit falsification on unseen material (holdout_calls_allowed = 0; dev is the overfit target, so this budget cannot decide it)
retiring the general boundary cues or the negation vocabulary
gold, micro-gold, threshold, or scorer changes
promoting any result to R2 acceptance
